facts.en: Completed a business diploma at Fictional Sparrow Institute in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构麻雀学院完成商科文凭课程。

facts.en: Operations clerk at Fictional Copper Grove from 2021-02 to 2023-08.
facts.zh: 2021-02 至 2023-08 在虚构铜树林机构任运营文员。

facts.en: Improvement support assistant at the same employer from 2023-09 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-09 至 2026-08 在同一雇主任改善支持助理。

facts.en: Maintained action logs and documented handover problems for team review.
facts.zh: 维护行动日志并记录交接问题供团队审核。

facts.en: Participated in a 2025 handover project with a team of 6 including the candidate.
facts.zh: 参与 2025 年交接项目，团队共 6 人，包含候选人。

facts.en: Personally interviewed 4 shift colleagues and drafted a handover checklist; the team lead approved the final process.
facts.zh: 个人访谈 4 名轮班同事并起草交接核对表；最终流程由团队负责人批准。

facts.en: The whole 6-person team received an internal collaboration award in 2025-12.
facts.zh: 整个 6 人团队于 2025-12 获得内部协作奖。

facts.en: The candidate was a team member, not a separately selected individual award winner.
facts.zh: 候选人为团队成员，并非单独评选的个人获奖者。

facts.en: For 3 observed weeks in 2025-09, 19 of 24 sampled handovers had owner names; no causal or long-term effect was established.
facts.zh: 2025-09 观察的 3 周中，24 份抽样交接记录有 19 份注明负责人；未建立因果或长期影响。

facts.en: Uses meeting notes, spreadsheet trackers and simple process diagrams.
facts.zh: 使用会议记录、电子表格跟踪表及简单流程图。

facts.en: Drafted a quarterly review agenda in 2026-01; only the first meeting used it.
facts.zh: 2026-01 起草季度审核议程；仅首次会议使用。

facts.en: Followed up action dates without authority to discipline or supervise staff.
facts.zh: 跟进行动日期，无纪律处分或人员管理权限。

facts.en: Attended an internal problem-solving workshop in 2024 without an external credential.
facts.zh: 2024 年参加内部问题解决工作坊，无外部资格。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Lantern Crafts during 2022-04 to 2022-09 on weekends.
facts.zh: 2022-04 至 2022-09 周末在虚构灯笼手工组织做志愿者。

facts.en: Prepared material lists for 5 volunteer craft sessions unrelated to the employer project.
facts.zh: 为 5 场志愿手工活动准备材料清单，与雇主项目无关。

facts.en: A 2020 coursework simulation compared fictional queue layouts; no physical process was changed.
facts.zh: 2020 年课程模拟比较虚构排队布局；未改变实际流程。

facts.en: Enjoys painting small cardboard scenery.
facts.zh: 爱好为小型纸板布景上色。

facts.en: Archived approved process versions with revision dates.
facts.zh: 归档获批流程版本及修订日期。

facts.en: A biography draft calls the candidate an individual award winner, inconsistent with the team award record.
facts.zh: 简介草稿称候选人为个人奖得主，与团队获奖记录不一致。

facts.en: No independent process-engineering certification or budget authority is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录独立流程工程认证或预算权限。
